# **Best billing software features for retail stores**


> The task of managing a retail shop involves performing fast transactions, using various payment systems, managing rush hours, and conducting exchanges. An ordinary invoice generator is a tool that can produce receipts for transactions, but there are many links that remain missing in the connection between your register, inventory, and accounting.


‍ **Billing software systems for retail shops** provide the possibility to link all these processes. You will have complete control over the stock and accounting, as well as manage your taxes and cash flow without using various instruments at once.


## **What should retail billing software really be doing?**


A full retail billing system will seamlessly integrate all stages of your store operation:


‍ **Product look-up → Checkout → Processing payments → Stock decrease automatically → Posting to the account → Sales analysis**


If after a product is sold, your software doesn’t update your stock and accounting automatically, if you need to do some manual corrections and balance register, then this isn’t really a retail point of sale software but merely invoice software. The feature set varies depending on the size of your business and counter configuration.


## **Fast and easy POS billing**


At peak times, your counter should be fast enough to avoid forming lines and making mistakes.


Some of the most important billing features are:


- **Scanning barcodes and quick search:** Scan items within a millisecond, or use hotkeys to search for items that don’t have barcodes.
- **Optimized touch screen:** Big buttons for faster register usage.
- **Quick changes:** Easily apply any discounts to specific items on the bill.
- **Fast returns and exchanges:** Find previous invoices for processing returns without slowing down the line.


**Suggested Read:**[Billing Software for Hardware Stores](https://getswipe.in/blog/billing-software/billing-software-for-hardware-stores)


## **Barcode billing & product management**


Pricing errors occur because of manual item selection. Barcode billing system integrates automatically by getting the price straight from your catalog. In the case of unbranded products, use software that can create and print barcodes from your purchase orders. Effective catalog management should keep track of product variations (sizes, colors, styles) under separate SKUs without overstuffing your inventory.


## **Real-time inventory management**


Inventory is your biggest asset. Link your checkout counter with retail inventory management to avoid stockouts and tying up your cash.


Important features of stock management include:


- **Automatic stock reduction:** Inventory updated right after completing the bill.
- **Low stock alerts:** Helps to make reorders before best selling items run out.
- **Vendor purchase orders entries:** Automatically update stock numbers for new vendor shipments.
- **Stock adjustments:** Helps to keep track of any damage, shrinkage, or usage.


## **GST-compliant billing**


To comply with GST regulations without doing any manual calculation, Indian retailers need good billing software for GST which would automatically calculate taxes:


- Automatically calculating CGST/SGST/IGST depending upon where the customer is located.
- Applying right HSN/SAC code depending upon product category.
- Issuing valid tax invoices with all necessary business information.
- Generating summaries in GSTR-1, e-Invoice, and e-Way Bills directly from sale record.

## **Different payment methods and payment tracking**


The modern-day shopper is always looking for different modes of payments. Hence, your billing software should support different payment methods.


Some of the features you may be looking for are:


- **UPI/Digital Wallets:** Generating dynamic QR Codes directly from the billing terminal.
- **Cards/Cash:** Combining card and cash payment method along with cash drawer reconciliation feature.
- **Split Payment:** Splitting one bill into two different payment methods (Cash + UPI).


## **Sales, purchases and business reports**


Use analytics to aid purchase and price decisions without assuming what will sell.


Type of Report Useful for Business Decisions


Product Sales Pinpoints high performers and products taking up shelf space.


Margins Shows net margins taking into account discounts and cost from suppliers.


Daily Settlements Checks for cash, UPI, and card payments end of day.


Stocks to Reorder Points out products requiring reorder or approaching shelf life.


## **Customer & supplier management**


- **Customer Details:** Manage your customers' purchasing records, their loyalty points, and their credit balance records to ensure repeat purchases.
- **Vendor Details:** Manage invoices of vendors, outstanding payables, and purchasing cost records to negotiate better prices.


**Suggested Read:**[Billing Software for Grocery Store](https://getswipe.in/blog/billing-software/billing-software-for-grocery-store)


## **Returns, exchanges, and discounts**


Return management manually leads to errors in inventory management. Return management is now integrated into modern retail store management software, where one can return to inventory, process refunds, and exchange items all at once.


## **Offline billing, backups, and data safety**


The internet must not stop your business at any time. Get software that supports offline billing so that billing processes are continuous without any delay due to internet issues. When the internet comes back online, the data will sync to the cloud. Access control will ensure safety from viewing confidential reports and costs.


## **Conclusion**


The ideal billing software characteristics for retail outlets extend beyond the basic process of printing an invoice. The ability to link your cash register with your stock levels, payments, and business reports will ensure that there is no need for manual recording and that the checkout process will be fast.


## **FAQs**


### **1. Is bar code compatibility necessary for retail billing?**


Yes. Barcode-based billing will prevent errors, save time, and keep track of the stock in your entire catalog automatically.


### **2. Can billing software help you with inventory management?**


Yes. Most of the latest billing software automatically updates the stock after sales, issues low-stock warnings, and maintains supplier records of new stock purchased.


### **3. Is the GST module necessary in retail billing software?**


If you are an Indian retailer, the GST module becomes mandatory for accurate calculations of GST rate, issuance of invoices, and tax payments.


### **4. What is the difference between billing and POS?**


Billing software simply helps in issuing the bill, whereas POS (Point of Sale) software integrates billing along with other functionalities.
